recommendationIntro: Recommended choices describe regular Auto Storm use; they are guidance and do not change saved settings.

steps.title: Open and capture your Storm castle

items.label: Open settings
items.description: Open Auto Storm settings from its Automation card.

items.label: Automatically open Storm castle
items.description: When Storm is locked, choose an available official starter castle and review its displayed price before allowing an unlock.
items.recommendation: On if you want Auto Storm to open a usual starter castle after reviewing its price.

items.label: Castle to open
items.description: Choose the currently available official Storm starter castle used for the next locked season.
items.recommendation: Choose an affordable usual starter after checking the price.

items.label: Storm castle
items.description: Select your current Storm castle before capturing a construction target.
items.recommendation: Capture the castle you intend to manage.

items.label: Functional capture
items.description: Save a target for essential Storm functions without copying every building position.
items.recommendation: Functional for normal upkeep.

items.label: Layout capture
items.description: Save building types and positions without decorations.
items.recommendation: Use only when building placement matters.

items.label: Exact capture
items.description: Save all supported target details for an exact clone.
items.recommendation: Use only after reviewing the full target.

items.label: Saved target
items.description: A captured target is saved and activated immediately, while Pause target stops reconciliation but keeps saved targets.
items.recommendation: Keep a reviewed Functional target active for normal building.

items.label: Decoration preset after construction
items.description: Optionally apply a selected decoration preset after construction.
items.recommendation: Leave empty unless you want a separate decoration layout.

items.label: Combat without a target
items.description: Fort and island combat does not require a captured construction target.

image.alt: Illustrative Auto Storm castle access and target capture
image.caption: Starter choice, capture modes and optional target activation; no live purchase or account shown.

items.label: Transport missing resources
items.description: Allow confirmed shipments of missing building resources from donor castles.
items.recommendation: On for regular construction.

items.label: Use construction time skips
items.description: Apply eligible time skips while keeping the selected item reserves.
items.recommendation: On if you want faster routine construction.

items.label: Allow premium costs
items.description: Allow eligible construction steps that spend premium currency.
items.recommendation: Off unless premium building is planned.

items.label: Allow demolition
items.description: Allow exact-target removal of buildings that cannot be moved or stored.
items.recommendation: Off unless you are rebuilding a reviewed layout.

items.label: Storm castle spending reserves
items.description: Keep the chosen Stormwood, stone and Aquamarine amounts unavailable to construction.
items.recommendation: Stormwood 0 and stone 0 if spending surplus; set Aquamarine to your planned reward budget.

items.label: Protected donor reserves
items.description: Keep chosen wood, stone and Aquamarine amounts at each donor before resource transport.
items.recommendation: Protect your usual wood and stone building budget; Aquamarine 0 when unused.

items.label: Time skips kept in reserve
items.description: Keep the selected number of each 1m, 5m, 10m, 30m, 1h, 5h and 24h item.
items.recommendation: Keep 0 of the short skips unless needed elsewhere; reserve your other-event stock of 1h, 5h and 24h skips.

items.label: Upgrade Harbor
items.description: Maintain the Harbor at your selected level even when the captured target differs.
items.recommendation: On with level 1 for regular use.

items.label: Harbor target level
items.description: Choose Harbor level 1, 2 or 3; levels 2 and 3 use premium construction paths.
items.recommendation: Level 1 unless premium upgrades are planned.

image.alt: Illustrative Auto Storm construction and reserve settings
image.caption: Resource transport, spending permissions, reserves and Harbor level are example controls.

items.label: Horse travel boost
items.description: Choose feather, coin or ruby travel for Storm attacks.
items.recommendation: Travel Feather for fast travel without choosing ruby travel.

items.label: Storm forts
items.description: Enable attacks on the selected official fort levels from 40 through 80.
items.recommendation: On for levels your selected preset can beat reliably.

items.label: Fort attack preset
items.description: Choose a saved troop and tool formation for forts.
items.recommendation: Use your regular fort preset.

items.label: Minimum attacks remaining
items.description: Only attack forts with at least this many attacks remaining.
items.recommendation: 0 to allow any eligible fort.

items.label: Resource islands
items.description: Enable capture of islands matching the chosen resources and sizes.
items.recommendation: On when you want Aquamarine from large and small islands.

items.label: Island resources
items.description: Choose which wood, stone or Aquamarine islands may be attacked.
items.recommendation: Select Aquamarine for Aquamarine farming.

items.label: Island sizes
items.description: Choose large, small or both sizes of selected resource islands.
items.recommendation: Large and small for regular Aquamarine farming.

items.label: Island attack preset
items.description: Choose a saved troop and tool formation for islands.
items.recommendation: Use your regular island preset.

items.label: Island defense units
items.description: Choose the types and amounts left to defend a captured island; an empty list leaves one survivor after a confirmed victory.
items.recommendation: Choose defenders if one survivor is insufficient for your plan.

items.label: Attack target priority
items.description: Order enabled island and fort targets; priority wins within a row and distance breaks ties.
items.recommendation: Large islands, small islands, then level 80 through 40 forts for Aquamarine farming.

image.alt: Illustrative Auto Storm fort and island attack settings
image.caption: Example Aquamarine islands, fort levels, target order and occupation defenders.

items.label: Import missing troops
items.description: Import missing attack or selected defense troops into Storm from chosen donor castles.
items.recommendation: On if your Storm castle needs regular troop supply.

items.label: Donor castles
items.description: Choose donor castles in the displayed order; partial stock can supply a smaller shipment.
items.recommendation: Select your usual troop suppliers in preferred order.

items.label: Minimum troops kept after launch
items.description: Keep at least this many troops in Storm after launching an attack while preserving the enabled preset mix.
items.recommendation: 1,000 troops for a regular reserve, adjusted to your actual army.

items.label: Average attacks since reset
items.description: Read the average number of Storm attacks reported since reset over the past 24 hours.
items.recommendation: Review this read-only estimate before changing import needs.

items.label: Average enabled preset
items.description: Read the average troops required by enabled attack presets, including chosen island defenders.
items.recommendation: Review this read-only estimate against your army.

items.label: Storm committed troop cap
items.description: Read the automatically calculated cap including stationed troops, movements, transit and returns.
items.recommendation: Review this read-only cap before increasing imports.

items.label: Map coverage
items.description: Review map scan coverage before relying on displayed targets.
items.recommendation: Wait for fresh coverage when targets are missing.

image.alt: Illustrative Auto Storm troop import and read-only estimates
image.caption: Donor order, 1,000 kept troops and read-only capacity estimates.

items.label: Keep Aquamarine
items.description: Keep this amount of Aquamarine unavailable to Luna purchases.
items.recommendation: 0 if all surplus may fund rewards; otherwise reserve your planned amount.

items.label: Find a Luna reward
items.description: Search the official Luna rewards by name before configuring a purchase.
items.recommendation: Search for the reward you actually want.

items.label: Use reward
items.description: Select a reward to make it eligible for automatic purchasing.
items.recommendation: Use only wanted rewards.

items.label: Cost and purchased cap
items.description: Read the game-reported cost and purchased cap for each reward.
items.recommendation: Check both read-only values before enabling.

items.label: Target total
items.description: Set the desired total purchased count for a limited reward.
items.recommendation: Set only the count you intend to buy.

items.label: Unlimited
items.description: Keep buying an eligible repeatable reward while the reserve and shop cap permit.
items.recommendation: On for regular repeatable rewards only.

items.label: Priority
items.description: Buy lower-numbered goals first, completing limited goals before unlimited ones.
items.recommendation: Use 1, 2 and 3 in your preferred order.

image.alt: Illustrative Auto Storm Luna reward settings
image.caption: Aquamarine reserve, limited purchase goals, repeatable rewards and priority.

items.label: Daily normal attack limit
items.description: Stop new Auto Storm attacks at the account-wide daily normal-attack count; 0 removes this added limit.
items.recommendation: 0 unless you use an account-wide cap.

items.label: Policy check interval
items.description: Set how often Auto Storm checks its settings and eligible work.
items.recommendation: Keep the usual 30-second interval.

items.label: Map refresh interval
items.description: Read the authoritative Storm map refresh interval.
items.recommendation: The read-only interval is 2 hours; wait for a fresh scan after changes.

items.label: Save settings
items.description: Save your castle, construction, combat, troop import and Luna selections before enabling automation.
items.recommendation: Save after reviewing all spending permissions.

items.label: Automation switch
items.description: Enable Auto Storm on its Automation card after the saved choices are ready.
items.recommendation: On after setup.

image.alt: Illustrative Auto Storm save and enable settings
image.caption: Daily attack limit, policy check, read-only map refresh and automation switch.
